d: Can a cumin-flavoured Indian soda take on Coca-Cola and Pepsi? Meet Lahori Zeera, the homegrown fizzy drink that is giving global cola giants a serious challenge. What began as a kitchen experiment by three cousins in 2017 has grown into a multi-million-dollar beverage business. As Indians rediscover traditional flavours like jeera, kokum, raw mango and tamarind, homegrown soda brands are gaining market share. Online orders are soaring, but rising costs, thin profit margins and competition from multinational giants pose major challenges. Is Lahori Zeera leading India's very own fizzy drink…
